prompt: The ¹H NMR spectrum below has two peaks. Molecular formula is C₈H₁₀. Which compound is it?
explanation: p-xylene has C2v symmetry: 2 equivalent methyls (one singlet, 6H) and 4 equivalent aromatic H (one singlet, 4H) — just TWO signals. o-xylene would also show 2 singlets but at slightly different shifts. Ethylbenzene shows 3 signals (CH₃ triplet, CH₂ quartet, aromatic multiplet). Styrene shows vinyl H's at δ 5-7.
